name: Aushopping
verdict: Aushopping is the shopping-centre network run by Nhood Services France.
note: Brand of the shopping-centre network formerly Ceetrus/Nhood; the LOSC partner is the V2 centre in Villeneuve d'Ascq branded Aushopping V2. Rating held: Nhood Services France's own shareholder is not stated on any open primary page found, so the chain stops at the operator.
